title: Bug: [BMC] test_syslog_rate_limit fails for redfish container
author: sanjair-git
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

- On BMC DUTs (NetworkBmc, e.g. H6-128 bmc-shared-mgmt topo), _tests/syslog/test_syslog_rate_limit.py_ intermittently fails when the random enabled container chosen for verification is redfish. 
- The same test passes for other containers (e.g. lldp, pmon) on the same image and testbed.

On BMC, redfish uses bridge-style Docker networking (_unlike typical host-network SONiC containers_). Container logs are not exposed on the host syslog path with a redfish# prefix, even though rate-limit configuration work.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run test_syslog_rate_limit test on BMC testbed. Repeat until redfish is selected.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

**Expected**:

- After config syslog rate-limit-container redfish and running the test redfish container, the test should observe _redfish#rate-limit-test_ messages on host /var/log/syslog and assert rate limiting (burst/interval), consistent with other containers that forward logs to host syslog.

**Actual:**

- Zero lines matching .*redfish#rate-limit-test: This is a test log:.* on host /var/log/syslog within the test’s wait.
- LogAnalyzer failure: expected messages missing for redfish#rate-limit-test.

### Relevant log output

```shell
tests.common.plugins.loganalyzer.loganalyzer.LogAnalyzerError: match: 0
expected_match: 0
expected_missing_match: 1
Expected Messages that are missing:
.*redfish#rate-limit-test: This is a test log:.*
```

### Output of `show version`

```shell
SONiC Software Version: SONiC.HEAD.1675636-msft-2608-be131c71
SONiC OS Version: 13
Distribution: Debian 13.6
Kernel: 6.12.41+deb13-sonic-arm64
Build commit: be131c71
Build date: Thu Sep 10 17:54:38 UTC 2026
```

linkedPullRequests.body: ### Description of PR Summary: Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/27880 This PR fixes issue #27880 On BMC, skip redfish in the random container syslog rate-limit test because host LogAnalyzer cannot see redfish# logs. Bridge-network redfish on BMC does not forward container logs to the host syslog path the test uses, while feature redfish still has _support_syslog_rate_limit_ set to true. ### Type of change - [ ] Bug fix - [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement) - [ ] New Test case - [ ] Skipped for non-supported platforms - [x] Test case improvement ### Back port request - [ ] 202311 - [ ] 202405 - [ ] 202411 - [ ] 202505 - [ ] 202511 - [ ] 202512 - [ ] 202605 Tracking issue/work item for backport/cherry-pick request (GitHub issue or Microsoft ADO): Failure type: ### Tested branch - [x] master - [ ] 202311 - [ ] 202405 - [ ] 202411 - [ ] 202505 - [ ] 202511 - [ ] 202512 - [ ] 202605 - [ ] N/A ### Test result ### Approach #### What is the motivation for this PR? - On H6-128 BMC (_NetworkBmc_), _test_syslog_rate_limit_ can randomly select the redfish container after config reload.
